text: LPPLS model describes log-price dynamics approaching critical point: \[y(t) = + (t_c - t)^m [B + C_1 \cos(\omega \log(t_c-t)) + C_2 \sin(\omega \log(t_c-t))]\] : \(t_c\) critical time (bubble peak) \(m\) power law exponent (typically 0.1-0.9) \(\omega\) (omega) log-periodic frequency (typically 6-13) \(\), \(B\), \(C_1\), \(C_2\) linear parameters damping coefficient D = m|B| / (ω√(C1² + C2²)) measures strength oscillations relative power law growth. Filimonov (2017) suggests D ≥ 0.8 valid bubble detection.
